facts.fact: The Central Bank of Libya regulates direct foreign remittances through licensed exchange companies by Circular 6 of 2026, a circular rather than a payments law.

facts.fact: Circular 6 of 2026 of the Central Bank of Libya authorises licensed exchange companies to send direct foreign remittances for companies and small traders via a unified platform, with a USD 100,000 per-transfer and USD 300,000 annual ceiling.
